title: Baked Tofu With Peanut Sauce and Coconut-Lime Rice
description: Crispy baked tofu coated in a spicy peanut-miso glaze, served over fragrant coconut-lime rice with fresh greens and pickled peppers.

ingredients.name: peanut or vegetable oil
ingredients.quantity: 2 tbsp, plus more for brushing and drizzling

ingredients.name: lime juice
ingredients.quantity: 2/3 cup (about 5 limes), plus zest of 1 lime

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 450°F and lightly oil a sheet pan.
Mix lime juice with salt and toss with sliced peppers; set aside.
Cook rice with coconut milk and water until tender, then let steam off heat.
Whisk peanut butter, miso, ginger, fish sauce, chili, oil, honey, lime juice, and water into a smooth sauce.
Arrange tofu on sheet pan, season, and coat with peanut sauce. Roast until caramelized, 18–20 minutes.
Mix remaining lime juice and honey into leftover sauce to make dressing.
Fluff rice with lime zest and scallions, assemble bowls with greens, rice, tofu, and sauce, and top with pickled peppers.
